description: Measured tarmac widths of navarra (tools/real_tracks_data/measure_width.py; derived data). Per route, sections every 5 m: centre (e, n) in the recipe's grid (BNG, or ETRS89 / UTM 30N in Spain), unit left normal (nx, ny), half-widths to the left and right tarmac edges (leftM, rightM; the built line's offset from the tarmac's middle is (leftM - rightM) / 2) and the lower edge confidence (conf, 0-1; below 0.5 the value is filled from neighbours or the circuit's median).
source: Gobierno de Navarra LiDAR 2024 point cloud with RGBI (LAZ, 1 km tiles, filescartografia.navarra.es)
attribution: Servicio proporcionado por el Gobierno de Navarra (IDENA), LiDAR 2024
method: LIDAR intensity (and RGB in Navarre) across the road every 5 m, edges where the surface stops being asphalt for 1 m (or a height step, objects, a painted line with paving beyond); width smoothed (sigma 12 m, at most 0.4 m per 5 m, 7-18 m), the line's offset smoothed (sigma 40 m)

unmeasured.reason: the 2024 extension (Turns 11-14) was unpaved or half-paved in the 2024 LIDAR flight
